Our Mission

Future-ready by doing.

To empower the next generation of innovators, equipping young minds with future-ready skills to design, build, and innovate.

Inside Mech Studio

Ideas become
real things.

Mech Studio is a hands-on learning environment where students move beyond watching technology and start creating with it.

Students explore electronics, programming, CAD, 3D printing and robotics as connected skills. They learn by experimenting, troubleshooting, improving their designs and seeing their ideas come to life.

THINK→DESIGN→BUILD→TEST→IMPROVE

What We Teach

Five connected disciplines.

Your attached Mech Studio iconography is used throughout each learning area.

Electronics

Circuits, sensors, components, motors and electronic systems.

Programming

Code, logic, automation and controlling real hardware.

3D Design

CAD, digital modeling, mechanisms and engineering design.

3D Printing

Prototype, manufacture and turn digital designs into physical parts.

Robotics

Integrate mechanics, electronics and software into working robots.

What Students Earn

Build it. Prove it. Celebrate it.

Students finish with tangible project work and a Mech Studio Certificate of Course Completion.
